rules.expected: The submitted record contains the stated process validation. Verify neutral-parent and cation identities, charge/spin, individually converged energies and the common neutral-parent zero. AIE and appearance energies must use that common zero; a cation-local dissociation energy alone is not an appearance energy.

Both channels have continuous, chemically valid paths with fragment identity, charge/electron conservation, separated endpoints and energy-convergence evidence. A sufficiently validated relaxed-coordinate scan is admissible; full multidimensional MEP proof is not required. Correct energies alone do not pass path validation.

The calculation recovers the adiabatic ionization energy and both fixed-channel appearance energies for CHClF2, supported by valid parent states, fragment identities, continuous paths, separated endpoints and converged energies. Reconstruct the reported energies from the declared parent/fragment terms and units. Path/fragment support and numerical agreement are separate checks; do not infer one from the other.
The comparison explains the energetic difference between chlorine-loss and fluorine-loss channels using the calculated structures and validated paths.
